text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~-right!
Motivation and the drive to win are totally maxed out~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, actually, my mom and dad sent me
a message of encouragement, so I'm totally fired up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I won't be my usual "ordinary" self today.
I'll show you an "ordinary" with a whole different flavor!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this!
Ei, ei, mun!
